I have been farming maize here in Iringa for many years, and I know this soil needs some help to give a good harvest. I will buy one bag of DAP fertilizer and also put manure on the plot because the land is rented and I need to make it productive this season. I will plant improved maize seed since the rains have been reliable in the Southern Highlands, but I do not see the need for chemicals to kill pests on maize. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes, though I may hire a few young men to help with the first clearing and weeding.
